target_reference_entry: Chuyu Wang, Lei Xie, Yuancan Lin, Wei Wang, Yingying Chen, Yanling Bu, Kai Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2021. Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration. Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies 5, 4 (2021), 1–25. doi:10.1145/3494975
paper_level_summary_zh: 本文在背景介绍中简要提及RFID感知作为低频率无线电信号用于细粒度活动识别的一个例子，仅将此文献归入相关工作的普通列举中，未对其核心能力（亚毫米级振动感知/隔墙窃听）进行展开讨论或确认。

evidences.evidence_quote: Wi-Fi sensing [9, 15, 19, 20, 36, 37], RFID sensing [35, 43], and 4G/5G sensing [7, 40].
evidences.evidence_context: Low-frequency radio signals have been widely leveraged for fine-grained human activity recognition (HAR), such as Wi-Fi sensing [9, 15, 19, 20, 36, 37], RFID sensing [35, 43], and 4G/5G sensing [7, 40].

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引文仅将[35]列为RFID感知的普通例子，未提及亚毫米级、振动、隔墙窃听等核心能力，属于典型的相关工作列举，不具备任何模板要求的确认或佐证价值。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 本文在引言中将目标论文归为低频率无线电信号用于细粒度活动识别的一般性RFID感知工作，未对其亚毫米级振动感知或隔墙窃听能力进行确认或讨论。
